VIKIT source and license scope (reviewed 2026-10-28)

Pinned fork: https://github.com/uavfly/vikit.git
Revision: f262533d04d99282ef63b2b3c8900eac71e6eafb
Original: https://github.com/uzh-rpg/rpg_vikit.git

The pinned ROS 2 commit changes vikit_common/package.xml from GPLv3 to BSD.
Its parent already declares GPLv3, and the inherited source retains GPL/PTAM,
LGPL and MIT notices. Both exact package files are preserved under licenses/.
The BSD-only package tag is therefore incomplete for this source selection.
The local package metadata now records the inherited licenses; this is a
metadata correction, not a new license grant by EasyFly or the fork maintainer.
The fork's BSD declaration remains evidence for its own contributions and
is not treated as permission to remove original conditions.

Applicable retained scopes:
- Original VIKIT package: GPLv3 (licenses/GPL-3.0.txt).
- homography.h/.cpp and PTAM-derived patch_score.h sections: GPLv3;
  Copyright 2008 Isis Innovation Limited. Their original notices remain.
- robust_cost.h/.cpp and file_reader.h: GPLv3 or later, Christian Kerl;
  vision.h also identifies DVO/GPL code. Keep their original notices.
- aligned_mem.h: LGPL 2.1, derived from libcvd, as stated in that header.
- ringbuffer.h: MIT, Copyright 2011 Hauke Strasdat; exact notice copied.

The library compiles pinhole_camera.cpp, math_utils.cpp, vision.cpp,
performance_monitor.cpp and robust_cost.cpp. All retained headers are installed;
source files not compiled are still part of the delivered source selection.
License texts and this scope record are installed with the package.
This record does not resolve the license compatibility of a combined downstream
binary merely by correcting metadata. In particular, FAST-LIVO2's GPLv2 package
and the GPLv3 VIKIT dependency require a separate combined-distribution review.
